name: Koizumi Mikuko
source:
A manager at the major game company Amaterasu Interactive.
She oversees the entire debugging department and manages the staff's work assignments and attendance.
Always expressionless, she carries herself like an elite professional, speaking and acting with the cold efficiency of a machine.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/4131220?emclan=103582791475366169&emgid=705529654727934533]Steam announcement[/url]]
